hero.title: Track performance, connected to your collection
hero.lead: Slot Race Manager connects to the DS200 timer, runs training and competitions on your computer, and can sync with Scalextric Collection so you can see your times and stats on the web after each session.

timing.title: Track timing
timing.blurb: Connect the DS200 timer and record every lap with precision.

training.title: Solo training
training.blurb: One lane, live metrics, history and files you can analyse in Excel.

competitions.title: Ranked competitions
competitions.blurb: Rally or simultaneous, heats, standings and TV mode.

realtime.title: Real time
realtime.text: Standings and metrics update lap by lap during a heat or a training session.

offline.title: Offline or with a cloud copy
offline.text: Works without internet. If you have a Scalextric Collection account and a connection, results upload when each session or heat ends; otherwise they are stored and sent when the network returns.

lights.title: F1-style lights
lights.text: Optional: connect electronic lights on a second cable and start races like in F1.

pilots.title: Multi-driver platform
pilots.text: Each driver links their own account and sees their times and stats on the web.

ds200.title: DS200 timing
ds200.description: The app connects to the DS200 timer, shows live standings and stores everything on your computer.
bullets: Millisecond times; duplicate timer readings are ignored automatically
Live standings: position, laps, total times, last lap, average, best time and gap to the leader
Adjustable minimum lap time to ignore bounce reads
You can void the last valid lap on each lane if there was a mistake
A heat can end by lap count, by time or by a timer signal

training.title: Training mode
training.description: A single-lane session with no target laps: stop when you want. Ideal for setup and rhythm work.
bullets: Last lap, delta vs the previous lap and your best, average of the last five
Trend, consistency and a chart of the last fifty laps
Session history with detail and a file download for Excel analysis

competition.title: Competition management
competition.description: Competitions with planned heats, overall and per-heat standings, and a second window for TV or projector.
bullets: Rally and Simultaneous modes; automatic heat plan and lane rotation
Start on first crossing, countdown or optional F1 lights hardware
Optional qualifying and heat generation from times
TV window and live standings for a second monitor
Download lap lists, summaries and full data for archive or Excel

sync.title: Sync with Scalextric Collection
sync.description: Optional: set this site’s address, the circuit and each driver’s access so times appear on their account.
bullets: Each driver gets access by signing in with email and password from the desktop app
Local cars are paired with the cars on the web account
Heats and training sessions are sent with every lap
If there is no network, results stay pending and can be sent later in one click

download.title: Download on the circuit PC
download.lead: Available for Windows: recommended installer or a single-file portable build. On the circuit PC you only need to install or copy the program, connect the DS200 timer and, if you use it, the optional lights.
download.installerText: Includes the usual Windows setup wizard. The easiest way to get the program ready on the circuit computer.
download.portableText: A single executable with no installer: handy for a quick try or a USB stick.
download.footnote: Built for Windows. Get the installer or executable from whoever distributes Slot Race Manager; on track you only need the program installed or copied.

finalCta.title: Turn on sync with Scalextric Collection
finalCta.lead: Create your account on this site, sign in from Slot Race Manager as a driver to link access, and pair cars and circuit so every session is reflected on your profile.
